title: Interesting and worth while visit to the past.
text:
We had a wonderful guide Coco who enthusiastic, informative, fun and a great person to tell the wonderful story of the past. On my visit to remains of the oldest Roman city in Española.
The trip was interesting, informative a great place to explore and find out facts about what happened to this wonderful place. I highly recommend going to visit this wonderful interesting site, exploring and imagining the lives these people lived, the frivolous lives , basking in the sun been fed grapes, and enjoying drinking wine and eating  wonderful foods and enjoying life.
author: lorrainey407

title: Great experience!
text: Jesus was an amazing tour guide he kept us engaged and explained everything in a way that made sense. He was very knowledgeable and you could tell that he was very interested in the topic!
author: 639maddieb

title: Wonderful Italica Ruins Tour with Emilie
text: Emilie was so incredibly knowledgeable and a fantastic guide during our tour. We visited during unseasonably hot weather and he did everything he could to help keep the tour enjoyable, including distracting some of the kids during our guided visit. He had great insights about the archeological site my family enjoyed him very much!
author: Amy_C
